is_anopheles.evidence: The study focuses on Anopheles arabiensis, a member of the Anopheles gambiae complex, as stated in the title and abstract.

reports_target_markers.evidence: The study reports on the L1014F (West African kdr) mutation in the voltage-gated sodium channel (VGSC), which corresponds to Vgsc L995F (Section 3.4).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Table 3 provides genotype counts for An. arabiensis: 38 homozygous resistant (RR), 3 heterozygous resistant (RS), and 171 homozygous susceptible (SS) out of 212 successfully amplified samples.

african_field_population.evidence: Mosquitoes were collected from five villages in Jabi Tehnan District, Northwest Ethiopia, between September 2016 and August 2017 (Section 2.1 and 2.3).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is a primary empirical study reporting original field collection and molecular analysis data.

sub_country_location.evidence: Data are reported for Jabi Tehnan District, with specific villages named: Jiga Yelimodar, Hodanshe Gatagon, Abasimo Zegay, Mender Meter, and Mebesh (Section 2.1).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Mosquito collections were conducted over a one-year period from September 2016 to August 2017 (Section 2.3).

duplicate_risk.evidence: The study describes original field collections in a district where data were previously scarce, and there is no indication that this is a subset of a larger published dataset.

supplement.evidence: All necessary genotype counts and location details are contained within the main text and tables of the provided document.

assessment.summary: This study reports the frequency of the Vgsc L995F (L1014F) mutation in field-collected Anopheles arabiensis from Jabi Tehnan District, Ethiopia. Mosquitoes were collected between September 2016 and August 2017 using various methods (HLC, CDC-LT, PSC, PS). Genotyping of 212 successfully amplified specimens revealed 38 RR, 3 RS, and 171 SS genotypes. No phenotypic insecticide susceptibility bioassays were conducted.
